description: Store the prep context: job description, and optionally company name and CV text, tied to a repo. Call this when the user pastes or describes any of them. Once set, use it throughout: in teach mode, point out where the code demonstrates JD-required skills; in interview mode, probe JD-required concepts the repo does NOT demonstrate (e.g. 'the JD requires Docker and your repo has no containerization — how would you containerize this app?'). The JD is returned by get_progress so returning sessions stay JD-aware.

company.description: Company name, for company-specific briefing and question style

cv_text.description: The candidate's CV/resume text — every claimed skill becomes bootcamp + interview material

job_description.description: The full job description text, or the user's summary of the role

repo.description: Repo id in owner/repo form this JD applies to

name: set_job_description
title: Set Job Description
